qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The exact word OR performs one replay-safe word read, computes the result before a final transactional word write, and publishes its lazy logical-flags descriptor only after the write succeeds.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete five-byte single instruction, OR operation, word width, immediate 0x10, RBX base, 0x3c displacement, and 64-bit address width must all match. An adjacent RIP, changed displacement, or changed immediate declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact word memory-OR block passes its tier-one differential and rejected-write matrix.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,497 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Input words 0x0000, 0x0001, 0x8000, and 0xffff match the interpreter for complete state, resulting memory, and logical-operation flags.
verification.faultCoverage: A forced final-write rejection preserves complete block-entry state and memory after exactly one write attempt.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP, a changed displacement, and a changed immediate all decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The exact 13,241-hit word memory-OR site is absent from the candidate's capped live negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 116,538 of 217,420 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
